subject: valkey-cli: Add word-jump navigation (Alt/Option/Ctrl + ←/→) (#2583)
reason: The change is confined to valkey-cli's interactive line editor (linenoise word-jump navigation and extended CSI escape parsing) plus a fix to the linenoise example program, which is not compiled into any shipped binary. The new code runs only inside linenoiseEdit, which is reached only when stdin is a TTY in raw mode; valkey.action.tools feeds valkey-cli through a pipe, so linenoise takes the linenoiseNoTTY path and the changed code never executes on either build — escape bytes on a pipe are treated as literal input, unchanged by this diff. No server command, reply, replication, or persistence
